youtube_description:
Michael Sylvia and Charles Fink ran a write-in campaign in the Republican primary on September 11, 2012 in Belmont, NH. They appeared on The Advocates Show with Niel Young and Harry Accornero prior to winning their slots on the November ballot.

Get more info at mikesylvia.org 

Full hour: http://www.wezs.com/audio/clips/Hour2.m3u
